title: Time-Blocking Planner — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Allocates specific time periods for work, study, and rest. The Time-Blocking Planner allocates specific periods for work and study. It divides the student's available hours into blocks assigned to tasks, classes, and breaks, protects the highest-energy hours for the hardest work, and leaves buffer blocks for overflow. The day becomes a concrete plan instead of a vague intention.
capabilities: Divide available hours into assigned blocks
Protect high-energy hours for hard work
Leave buffer blocks for overflow
Assign tasks to specific blocks
